hooks.name: pin-leak-guard
hooks.description: Coarse guard: fail if runtime code passes text or pin to a logging call. Heuristic only; the canary-PIN test is the real check.

action.command: if grep -rnE '(log|logger|logging|print)[A-Za-z_.]*\(.*\b(text|pin)\b' backend/src/revenant/runtime --include=*.py; then echo 'PIN LEAK GUARD: a log or print call mentions text or pin. See steering security-pin-secrets.md.' >&2; exit 1; fi
